# FAQ-025 Engineering FAQ #25
Revision: Rev A

Q1: What lubricant do I order for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01), and where is it used?
A1: The lubricant part number for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is CFW-LUB-724. Background: This lubricant is the factory-specified oil for bearings and ring roll contact points on the Hot Forge radial mill. Rationale: Using the specified part ensures compatibility with seals, bearing materials, and anticipated thermal exposure in forging operations. Example: When replenishing the main bearing sump prior to a planned production campaign, verify that the shipping label and vendor packing list match CFW-LUB-724 before transferring to factory containers. Records to keep: procurement receipt for CFW-LUB-724, batch or lot number from the supplier, and a copy of the signed issue log that shows quantity issued to EQ-P2-L1-RR01. Reference: See ECN-2026-043 for the approved lubricant change justification.

Q2: Which lubricant is specified for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L4-RR01), and why is it different from other mills?
A2: The lubricant part number for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L4-RR01) is CFW-LUB-723. Background: Heat treat area contamination risk and elevated surface conditions influence lubricant selection; CFW-LUB-723 was selected for its formulation that balances cooling residues and corrosion protection in that environment. Rationale: Separating lubricant part numbers reduces cross-contamination risk between heat treat and other process areas and aligns with segregation controls in the lubrication management plan. Example: If performing a scheduled bearing replacement in the heat treat mill, confirm that the fill container is labeled CFW-LUB-723 and that the transfer pump is dedicated or cleaned per SOP-P2-L4-03. Records to keep: maintenance work order indicating use of CFW-LUB-723, container label copy, and any post-service cleanliness swab results. Reference: See SOP-P2-L4-03 for contamination prevention during lubricant handling.

Q3: How long should I warm up the spindle on Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03) before starting critical cuts?
A3: The spindle warm-up time for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03) is 27 minutes. Background: A controlled spindle warm-up stabilizes thermal growth and lubricant film development to achieve repeatable spindle geometry. Rationale: Following a prescribed warm-up time reduces part-to-part variation during the initial run-in period after machine start or after extended idle. Procedure example: With the machine in READY state, initiate the spindle warm-up program and allow the automated sequence to run for 27 minutes before loading the first critical production part. Records to keep: warm-up log entry noting start and completion times for the 27 minutes, operator initials, and any deviations observed during warm-up. Reference: See MM-P3-L3-CN02 for the spindle handling checklist.

Q4: What is the way lube refill interval for Machining CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P3-L3-CN02), and how should refills be performed?
A4: The way lube refill interval for Machining CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P3-L3-CN02) is 70 hours. Background: Way lubrication interval is defined to maintain film thickness on slideways and prevent accelerated wear during normal machining cycles. Rationale: Adhering to the 70 hours interval prevents both under-lubrication and over-filling, the latter of which can attract contaminants. Procedure example: Track run time using the machine hour meter and schedule a refill at the next available planned maintenance window once the cumulative run time reaches the 70 hours threshold. Use approved filling tools and follow the machine's fill point sequence as documented in MM-P3-L3-CN02. Records to keep: way lube log with the cumulative hours reading at refill, lubricant used, operator initials, and any comments about leakage or abnormal wear observed. Reference: See MM-P3-L3-CN02 for the refill procedure and verification checklist.

Q5: What lubricant should be used for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01), and how do we ensure traceability?
A5: The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is CFW-LUB-961. Background: The ring rolling cell uses a lubricant selected for load carrying and compatibility with cold-forming process residues. Rationale: Using part CFW-LUB-961 as the designated lubricant ensures consistency across the ring rolling cell and supports predictable tool life and surface finish outcomes. Procedure example: When receiving a new shipment, quarantine inventory until a receiving inspection confirms the vendor label matches CFW-LUB-961 and the certificate of analysis is attached. Transfer approved containers to the cell storage cabinet and label shelf locations with CFW-LUB-961 for easy identification. Records to keep: receiving inspection form, certificate of analysis for the lot of CFW-LUB-961, issue log entries linking specific container lot numbers to maintenance tasks on EQ-P1-L2-RR01, and any deviation forms if substitutions were attempted. Reference: See ECN-2026-043 for authorization history if substitutions are proposed and SOP-P2-L4-03 for cross-area handling controls.

Related documents cited: ECN-2026-043, MM-P3-L3-CN02, SOP-P2-L4-03.
